subject: Kickoff: Credentialing & technical owner alignment for ClearBridge tenant
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Saira Khan <saira.khan@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Credentialing & technical owner alignment for ClearBridge - next steps

Hi Saira / Alex —

Great to have ClearBridge moving into implementation. Quick note to capture the credentialing & access items we need to get the tenant live.

Goals for this thread: align on the primary technical owner, decide project namespace and keying model, and schedule invites/API key seed.

Proposed 3-step plan (target completion: Nov 25):
- Confirm technical owner + admin emails (we issue initial admin invites).
- Decide keying model: service-account (recommended) vs. per-user API keys + rotation cadence.
- Redwood seeds a project namespace and creates a service account with scoped tokens for first-week traffic.

Asks for ClearBridge this week:
- Confirm technical owner (name + email).
- List of admin users to receive invites (up to 5).
- Any IP allowlist / egress restrictions we should add to the workspace.
- Preference on KMS for key wrapping (Bring Your Own KMS) or Redwood-managed.

Attached: ClearBridge-Kickoff-Plan.pdf (quick timeline + responsibilities).

I’ll leave Connor and Karthik to outline the exact seed steps once you confirm the owner.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
Attachments: ClearBridge-Kickoff-Plan.pdf (pdf, 152KB)

From: Saira Khan <saira.khan@clearbridge.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@clearbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Credentialing & technical owner alignment for ClearBridge - next steps

Hi Monica —

Thanks — happy to confirm some of this from our side.

Technical owner: Saira Khan (me) — saira.khan@clearbridge.com
Initial admin list to invite:
- Saira Khan <saira.khan@clearbridge.com> (Tech lead)
- Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@clearbridge.com> (Platform eng)
- Priya Rao <priya.rao@clearbridge.com> (Security)

A few clarifications:
- We prefer a service-account model for now, with tokens rotated every 30 days. Do you support short-lived tokens + refresh?
- We use AWS KMS and would like BYOK if possible — can you list the KMS integrations/options?
- We'll provide an initial IP allowlist (coming in a follow-up).

If you can seed the namespace "clearbridge-prod" and create a service-account seed token, that would expedite testing.

Best,
Saira
Senior Platform Architect, ClearBridge Health
Attachments: —

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: ACTION: seed clearbridge-prod namespace + service account (internal)

Karthik / Connor —

Following Saira's confirmation: please take these actions and report status by EOD Nov 24. I'll coordinate invites with Monica once seeds are ready.

Immediate tasks:
1) Create namespace: clearbridge-prod (tenant: clearbridge / env: prod).
2) Create service-account: redwood-cb-initial-sa with minimal scopes: generate:create, inference:call (token restricted to first-week TTL 30d but configurable).
3) Seed 1 short-lived API token (expires 2026-12-23) and store in vault: path /tenants/clearbridge/prod/service-accounts/redwood-cb-initial-sa.
4) Prepare invite links for admin users (Saira, Alex, Priya) and confirm they are scoped to the admin role described in the kickoff doc.
5) Attach onboarding-mini-arch.png to the implementation ticket and update the Jira: SUP-1129 with links.

Attachments: seed-ops-checklist.csv (simple task checklist for the seed).

Notes: Karthik — please confirm BYOK flow for AWS KMS (we will need a short guide for Priya). Connor — check that the IP allowlist config is available for the namespace; if not, note alternatives (CIDR or gateway).

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Attachments: seed-ops-checklist.csv (csv, 4KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Saira Khan <saira.khan@clearbridge.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Credentialing & technical owner alignment for ClearBridge - keying model + KMS

Hi Saira —

Thanks for confirming. Short answers up front:
- Yes — we will seed a service-account and provide a short-lived token with optional refresh via the Redwood runtime. By default the seed token TTL is 30 days; we can issue rotated tokens programmatically and we support an automated rotation webhook or you can pull fresh tokens from your vault.
- BYOK for AWS KMS: supported. We have a documented flow where we request a cross-account CMK policy and then configure key-wrapping on the tenant. I'll attach the BYOK checklist and a Drive link to the step-by-step guide.

On the namespace + seed: we created clearbridge-prod (namespace id: clearbridge-prod-7f2). redwood-cb-initial-sa created and seeded into our vault with a seed token expiring 2026-12-23.

On invites: Hannah will send admin invites after we confirm IP allowlist.

Drive references: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bClearBridgeKickoff (BYOK and runbook)
